body.statement: Every two real closed fields satisfy the same first-order sentences in the language of ordered fields.  In particular, a first-order sentence with rational coefficients holds over \(\mathbb R\) if and only if it holds over the real algebraic closure of \(\mathbb Q\).

source.locator: Quantifier-elimination theorem for real closed fields

attestation.note: The displayed transfer consequence is the exact model-theoretic fact used; the stable publisher page is supplied.
